name: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 3 large onions, thinly sliced and fried (birista)
A few strands of saffron soaked in 2 tbsp warm milk
Whole spices: 2 bay leaves, 4 cloves, 4 green cardamoms, 1 cinnamon stick
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric, salt and half the biryani masala for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a pot, add whole spices, then add marinated chicken and cook until oil separates.
Add chopped tomatoes and green chilies, cook until chicken is tender and gravy thickens.
Separately, boil the soaked rice in salted water with whole spices until 70% cooked, then drain.
Layer half the rice over the chicken gravy, sprinkle fried onions, mint, coriander and saffron milk. Repeat with remaining rice on top.
Cover with a tight lid (or dough seal) and cook on low heat (dum) for 20-25 minutes.
Gently mix before serving hot with raita.

name: Beef Biryani
ingredients: Whole spices (bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves)
steps: Marinate beef with yogurt, ginger garlic paste and spices for 1 hour.
Cook marinated beef in oil with whole spices and tomatoes until tender (pressure cooking speeds this up).
Par-boil the rice with whole spices until 70% done, then drain.
Layer rice over the beef gravy with fried onions, herbs and saffron milk.
Seal and cook on dum (low heat) for 20-25 minutes.
Mix gently and serve hot.

name: Chicken Karahi
ingredients: Fresh ginger julienne and coriander for garnish
steps: Heat oil in a karahi (wok), add chicken pieces and cook on high heat until they change color.
Add ginger garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes and cook until they break down and oil separates.
Add salt, red chili flakes, black pepper and green chilies, cook until chicken is tender.
Garnish with ginger julienne and coriander, serve hot with naan.

name: Mutton Karahi
ingredients: Coriander and ginger julienne for garnish
steps: Heat oil, add mutton and cook on high heat until browned.
Add ginger garlic paste and cumin seeds, cook briefly.
Add tomatoes, salt and a little water, cover and simmer until mutton is tender (45-60 min).
Once oil separates, add chili flakes, black pepper and green chilies.
Garnish and serve hot with roti.

name: Nihari
ingredients: 1 kg beef shank with bone marrow
3 tbsp nihari masala (or homemade blend of chili, coriander, fennel, garam masala)
1/4 cup wheat flour, mixed with water into a paste
Ginger julienne, coriander, lemon and green chilies for garnish
steps: Heat oil, fry sliced onion until golden, then add ginger garlic paste and nihari masala.
Add beef shank pieces and cook until sealed on all sides.
Add enough water to cover the meat, cover and simmer on low heat for 3-4 hours until meat is falling off the bone (or pressure cook to save time).
Stir in the wheat flour paste slowly to thicken the gravy, simmer for another 15 minutes.
Serve hot topped with ginger julienne, coriander, green chilies and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Haleem
ingredients: 500g beef or chicken, cut into pieces
1 cup mixed lentils (chana daal, masoor, moong), soaked
1/2 cup broken wheat or barley, soaked
Ghee, fresh coriander, mint, lemon, ginger julienne for garnish
steps: Boil meat with ginger garlic paste, turmeric and salt until very tender; shred the meat finely.
Separately boil soaked lentils and wheat/barley until completely soft, then blend into a coarse paste.
Combine the meat and lentil-wheat mixture, cook together on low heat, stirring often, until it reaches a thick porridge consistency.
Add red chili powder and garam masala, simmer for 20 more minutes.
Top with fried onions, ghee, ginger julienne, coriander, mint and a squeeze of lemon before serving.

name: Chicken Pulao
ingredients: 4 cups chicken stock (from boiling the chicken)
Whole spices: cumin, cardamom, cinnamon, bay leaf
steps: Boil chicken with whole spices to make a flavorful stock; remove chicken and set aside.
In a pot, fry onions in oil until golden, add ginger garlic paste and chicken pieces, lightly fry.
Add pulao masala and the reserved stock, bring to a boil.
Add soaked rice, adjust salt, cover and cook on low heat until rice is fully cooked and fluffy.
Fluff gently with a fork and serve hot with raita.

name: Seekh Kebab
ingredients: 1 onion, finely chopped and squeezed dry
steps: Mix mince with onion, ginger garlic paste, chilies, spices, coriander and salt until well combined.
Cover and let it rest in the fridge for at least 20 minutes so it firms up.
Shape the mixture around skewers into long kebabs.
Grill over charcoal or cook on a hot pan/tawa, turning occasionally, until cooked through and charred on the outside.
Serve hot with naan, chutney and salad.

name: Chapli Kebab
steps: Mix mince with onion, tomato, chilies, ginger garlic paste, spices, anardana and gram flour until well combined.
Shape into flat, round patties.
Shallow fry in hot oil on medium heat until golden brown and cooked through on both sides.
Serve hot with naan and salad.

name: Aloo Gosht (Meat & Potato Curry)
steps: Fry onions in oil until golden, add ginger garlic paste and meat, cook until browned.
Add tomatoes and spices, cook until oil separates.
Add water, cover and simmer until meat is nearly tender.
Add potatoes and cook until both meat and potatoes are fully tender.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot with rice or roti.

name: Kimchi Jjigae (Kimchi Stew)
ingredients: 2 cups ripened kimchi, chopped, with some of its juice
200g pork belly or spam, sliced (optional for non-veg version)
steps: In a pot, stir-fry the kimchi and pork (if using) in sesame oil for a few minutes.
Add water or stock, garlic, gochugaru and gochujang, bring to a boil.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes until the kimchi softens and flavors meld.
Add tofu and onion, simmer for 5 more minutes.
Garnish with spring onion and serve hot with steamed rice.

name: Bibimbap
ingredients: 1 cup bean sprouts, blanched and seasoned
150g beef bulgogi (marinated and cooked, see Bulgogi recipe)
steps: Prepare each vegetable separately: saute carrot and zucchini, blanch and season spinach and bean sprouts with sesame oil and salt.
Cook the beef bulgogi in a hot pan until caramelized.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up, keeping yolks runny.
Place rice in a bowl, arrange vegetables and beef around the edges in sections, top with a fried egg.
Add a spoonful of gochujang in the center, sprinkle sesame seeds, and mix everything together before eating.

name: Bulgogi (Korean Marinated Beef)
steps: Mix grated pear, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger and pepper into a marinade.
Marinate the beef slices for at least 30 minutes (longer for more flavor).
Heat a pan or grill on high heat, cook the marinated beef with onions until caramelized and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Garnish with spring onions and sesame seeds, serve with rice and lettuce wraps.

name: Japchae (Stir-fried Glass Noodles)
steps: Boil the glass noodles according to package instructions, drain and toss with a little sesame oil and soy sauce.
Blanch spinach briefly, season with salt and sesame oil.
Stir-fry carrot, onion, mushrooms and beef (if using) separately with garlic, soy sauce and sugar until cooked.
Combine noodles with all the vegetables and beef in a large bowl, toss well with remaining soy sauce and sesame oil.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Tteokbokki (Spicy Rice Cakes)
steps: If rice cakes are hard/refrigerated, soak them in warm water for 10-15 minutes to soften.
In a pan, combine stock, gochujang, gochugaru, sugar and soy sauce, bring to a simmer.
Add rice cakes and fish cakes, cook until the sauce thickens and coats the rice cakes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Garnish with spring onion and serve hot, with a boiled egg on the side if desired.

name: Kimbap
ingredients: 3 cups cooked short-grain rice, seasoned with sesame oil and salt
2 eggs, made into a thin omelette and sliced into strips
4 imitation crab sticks or ham strips
steps: Lay a seaweed sheet on a bamboo mat, spread a thin layer of seasoned rice leaving a small border at the top.
Arrange carrot, cucumber, egg, spinach, crab stick and pickled radish in a line across the rice.
Using the mat, roll tightly from the bottom, sealing the edge with a little water.
Brush the roll lightly with sesame oil, then slice into bite-sized pieces with a sharp knife.
Repeat with remaining ingredients and serve at room temperature.

name: Korean Fried Chicken
steps: Season chicken with salt and pepper, coat well in cornstarch.
Deep fry in batches at medium heat until golden and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes. Remove and drain.
Fry a second time briefly at higher heat for extra crispiness, then drain again.
In a pan, combine gochujang, honey, soy sauce, garlic and rice vinegar, simmer until slightly thickened.
Toss the fried chicken in the sauce until well coated, garnish with sesame seeds and serve immediately.

name: Sundubu Jjigae (Soft Tofu Stew)
steps: In a pot, cook minced meat (if using) with sesame oil, garlic and onion until browned.
Add gochugaru and gochujang, stir briefly, then add stock and bring to a boil.
Gently spoon in the soft tofu (don't stir too hard, keep it chunky), simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Crack an egg into the center of the stew just before serving and let it cook slightly in the residual heat, or stir it in fully cooked.
Garnish with spring onion and serve bubbling hot with steamed rice.
